defects.invariant: Malformed or unknown request input is rejected before effects; every HTTP failure is a typed JSON envelope and logs contain no query secrets.
Default redaction removes credentials recursively without changing output types or corrupting JSON and NDJSON.
Every shipped output mode, fields selector, tag command, help alias, and agent-mode error has one truthful stable representation.
Flag, environment, file, and default precedence is observable and all config sources are validated without traceback or silent control drift.
The Run Ledger fingerprints the complete transmitted request identity without secrets and never records a crashed command as success.
Fuzz plans are byte-faithful, bounded, fully preflighted before effects, lazy in memory, and account for every baseline and attempted shot.
H2 state is owner-only, resource-safe, transactionally consistent, concurrency-safe, and queried with validated normalized filters.
Repeater inputs obey XOR and batch preflight; response-less sends and post-effect persistence failures are reported without encouraging duplicate mutation retries.
Session credentials are immutable per send, atomically persisted, syntactically safe, origin-bound, and cleared independently from observed cookies.
Endpoint extraction follows RFC URI resolution and credential boundaries; diffs use UTF-8 bytes and preserve duplicate headers.
Proxy filters and pagination are exact and safe, intercept state is authoritative, unsupported controls fail, and WebSocket metadata comes from capture time/identity.
Scanner work is bound to the supplied target, reflects Montoya task state/counts, is cleaned up, and never claims unsupported pause/resume/all behavior.
Security checks distinguish observations, inconclusive probes, anomalies, and confirmed classifier findings; invalid plans have zero effects.
Server-side Intruder truthfully supports bounded byte-accurate sniper attacks with a legal concurrent lifecycle and a fresh quick-fuzz baseline.
Scope mutation responses come from the engine and unimplementable complete listing/replacement never claim authority.
Project/user configuration endpoints export and import actual nested Burp JSON rather than returning successful stubs.
Collaborator payload and interaction identity, time, address, protocol details, correlation, and operational failures come from Montoya authority.
Every route and shipped CLI command has an executable current contract, identifiable build provenance, package smoke coverage, and enforced CI quality gates.

findingSchema.duplicateRule: A finding matching an indexed invariant and rootCause with no novel failing effect is existing-verified-or-regression and cannot be issue-ready.
